body:
Shipped the real priority: Alt+E extrudes a selected face into a new connected box, auto-selecting its far face so extrudes chain -- matches the founder's own hallway-building workflow. Tab/Alt+3 mode switching, all hotkeys Alt-modified to avoid colliding with S487's camera-fly keys. Also found+fixed a real, separate bug: constrain-Y drag was re-adding a nonzero grabOffset.Y on top of the plane-locked Y, drifting walls up/down on drag depending on click position -- now forces Y to the wall's own unchanged startWall.y. Full arbitrary-mesh editing (vertex/edge, TransformControls gizmo, ramps) scoped in new docs2/MESH_EDITING_NORTHSTAR.md, explicitly not built this pass. tsc/vite clean, deployed, verified in dist/ and the binary. IDUNA e3fcb2e.

⚓ ☃
title: Box extrude (Phase 1) + constrain-Y drag fix in NOCK level editor (S488)
